HND.tagline: Where neon futures meet ancient tradition.
HND.intro: Tokyo is a dizzying blend of cutting-edge technology and serene historical shrines. It is a playground for students offering endless street food, pop culture, and seamless urban adventure.
HND.didYouKnow: Tokyo has more Michelin-starred restaurants than any other city in the world.

highlights.title: Shibuya Crossing
highlights.note: The world's busiest, most iconic pedestrian intersection.

highlights.title: Senso-ji Temple
highlights.note: Tokyo's oldest temple, located in historic Asakusa.

highlights.title: Akihabara
highlights.note: The global epicenter for anime, gaming, and electronics.

highlights.title: Shinjuku Gyoen
highlights.note: A massive, peaceful park perfect for relaxing.

TGD.tagline: Where Balkan grit meets Mediterranean soul.
TGD.intro: Podgorica is a unique blend of socialist-era architecture, modern cafe culture, and stunning natural landscapes. It serves as the perfect low-cost base for students to explore Montenegro’s rugged mountains and sparkling coastline.
TGD.didYouKnow: The city has been rebuilt multiple times throughout history, leaving it with a rare mix of Ottoman-era relics and brutalist urban design.

highlights.title: Millennium Bridge
highlights.note: An iconic, sleek cable-stayed bridge over the Morača.

highlights.title: Stara Varoš
highlights.note: The historic old town featuring Ottoman-style architecture.

highlights.title: Ribnica River Banks
highlights.note: Popular chill spots for riverside coffee and sunsets.

highlights.title: Njegošev Park
highlights.note: The city's green heart for budget-friendly relaxation.

PED.tagline: Gingerbread charm and thrilling horse races
PED.intro: Pardubice is a vibrant student hub famous for its historic square and unique gingerbread tradition. It perfectly blends medieval architecture with a lively, modern social scene.
PED.didYouKnow: The city is home to the Velká Pardubická, one of the world's most difficult and oldest steeplechase horse races.

highlights.title: Pardubice Castle
highlights.note: Renaissance fortress with stunning ramparts.

highlights.title: Green Gate
highlights.note: Iconic tower offering panoramic city views.

highlights.title: Gingerbread Museum
highlights.note: Taste and decorate traditional local treats.

highlights.title: Pernštýn Square
highlights.note: The heart of the city’s social life.

ABJ.tagline: The pulsating, stylish heartbeat of West Africa
ABJ.intro: Abidjan is a vibrant urban jungle blending futuristic skyscrapers with tropical lagoon charm. It is the ultimate student hub for world-class nightlife, diverse Ivorian gastronomy, and an infectious creative energy.
ABJ.didYouKnow: Abidjan is often called the 'Paris of West Africa' due to its sophisticated cafe culture and French-influenced architecture.

highlights.title: Plateau District
highlights.note: The city’s high-rise financial heart and skyline.

highlights.title: St. Paul's Cathedral
highlights.note: Striking, modern architecture with panoramic lagoon views.

highlights.title: Treichville Market
highlights.note: A chaotic, authentic hub for local street food.

highlights.title: Bingerville
highlights.note: Historic colonial capital featuring lush botanical gardens.

SKP.tagline: The vibrant gateway to Skopje's outskirts.
SKP.intro: Ilinden is a dynamic municipality offering a perfect blend of modern suburban life and convenient access to the capital. It serves as a bustling transit hub where local culture meets the fast pace of urban North Macedonia.
SKP.didYouKnow: The municipality is named after the historic Ilinden Uprising of 1903, a pivotal moment in the nation's fight for independence.

highlights.title: St. George Church
highlights.note: A peaceful spot for historical reflection.

highlights.title: Skopje Airport Vicinity
highlights.note: Strategic location for easy travel access.

highlights.title: Local Sports Facilities
highlights.note: Great spots to engage with active locals.

highlights.title: Traditional Taverns
highlights.note: Authentic spots for affordable Macedonian cuisine.

ESB.tagline: The beating heart of modern Turkey
ESB.intro: Ankara is a dynamic student hub where ancient history meets contemporary urban life. It offers a unique window into Turkey's soul beyond the coastal resorts, packed with world-class museums and a buzzing cafe scene.
ESB.didYouKnow: Ankara was a small provincial town until it was declared the capital of the Republic of Turkey in 1923.

highlights.title: Anıtkabir
highlights.note: The monumental mausoleum of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk.

highlights.title: Ankara Castle
highlights.note: Historic fortress offering panoramic city views.

highlights.title: Museum of Anatolian Civilizations
highlights.note: A premier collection of ancient history artifacts.

highlights.title: Kızılay Square
highlights.note: The vibrant epicenter of local student life.
